notes.text: Business model: Website Factory. Build and sell professional websites to local home-service contractors (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing) using GHL. One-time fee $797-$1,997 + optional $97-$197/month retainer. Starting niche: HVAC and plumbing contractors in mid-size US cities who have no website or a broken one.

Prospecting approach: use web_search to find local HVAC/plumbing businesses that have a GBP listing but no website link (or a broken website). Target cities: Tulsa OK, Fresno CA, Albuquerque NM, Baton Rouge LA, Knoxville TN. These are large enough to have many contractors but small enough that competition from web agencies is lower.

Pricing and positioning: Lead with 'We build your website in 48 hours, or it\'s free.' Starter package $797 (5-page site, lead form, GMB embed). Pro package $1,297 (+ SEO setup, booking calendar). Monthly care plan $97/month. Do NOT compete on price with overseas agencies — compete on speed and local focus.

GHL setup needed: create a 'Website Factory' pipeline with stages: Outreach -> Replied -> Discovery Call -> Proposal Sent -> Deposit Paid -> Build In Progress -> Launched -> Retainer Active. Also need a website template in GHL Website Builder for contractor sites (header, services, about, reviews, contact/booking).

tasks.text: Call ghl_list_pipelines to see existing pipelines. If no 'Website Factory' pipeline exists, queue approval for human to create it in GHL UI with stages: Outreach, Replied, Discovery Call, Proposal Sent, Deposit Paid, Build In Progress, Launched, Retainer Active.
Call ghl_list_funnels to inventory existing GHL website templates. Note any contractor-friendly template names for reuse.

Use web_search to find 10 HVAC or plumbing contractors in Tulsa OK that have a GBP listing but no website or a clearly broken/outdated one. Record each prospect as a note with: business name, phone, address, GBP URL if found, website status.

Draft a cold outreach script (email + SMS variant) for HVAC/plumbing contractors. Should be short, specific, and lead with the pain (no website = lost calls). Queue it for human approval before sending any real messages.

For each prospect found in task 3: create a GHL contact with tag 'prospect-hvac-tulsa' and a matching opportunity in the pipeline at stage 'Outreach' with monetary_value=997. Requires pipeline_id from task 1.
Research: what domain registrar/host to use for client sites built on GHL? Options: GHL native domain, Cloudflare Registrar, Namecheap. Recommend one and note it.

Draft a one-page 'Website Factory' proposal PDF outline that Ron can generate for interested prospects: what's included, timeline (48h), price tiers, payment terms (50% deposit, 50% on launch), and monthly care plan upsell.
